main.description: A whole list the account chose to publish on LP/EP Finder (lpepfinder.com): its wantlist (record key "wants") or its collection (record key "collection"). The list itself is a JSON blob, so a list of 10,000 records is one write. Wants: {"version":1,"kind":"wants","items":[[releaseKey, "Artist – Title", discogsReleaseId or 0, coverUrl or ""], …]}. Collection: {"version":1,"kind":"collection","keys":[releaseKey, …]}. A release key is 12 hex characters derived from the record's artist and title, the same in every shop.
